scope: Single Promotions page, all partner images loaded; default and prefers-contrast: more rendering.
limitations: An automated audit does not establish complete WCAG conformance.
The default rendering preserves gold and muted colors from the supplied design; the reported contrast failures remain in that rendering.
The hero gradient requires manual contrast review because axe cannot determine its background colors.

manualChecks.methodology: WCAG relative-luminance contrast formula, using the brightest declared gradient stop as the conservative background; darker stops increase contrast.

violations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
